page.title: Capstan | A glove that helps your hand grip again
page.metaDescription: A glove for weak hands from CMT. Turn the dial and it closes your hand and holds on. Open jars, turn keys, hold your fork. No motor, no battery.
page.h1: A glove that helps your hand grip again.
page.lead: Turn the dial at your wrist. The glove closes your hand and holds on. Open the jar. Turn the key. Hold your fork. No motor. No battery. Nothing to charge.

problemBody: You drop things. Jars will not open. Buttons take forever. Writing hurts.
And you have heard it before: there is nothing for your hands. Until now, that was true.
page.whyHead: Legs get braces. Hands got nothing.
whyBody: Most people with CMT can get a brace for their legs. For hands, nothing added strength. Capstan does.

whyStats.small: people with CMT wear a brace on their legs or ankles
have anything at all for their hands

page.proofHead: Meet Mushruf, the first person to wear it.
page.proofStory: Mushruf is a close friend of our founder. He has CMT. The first Capstan was built for him, and he got it free. He has worn it every day for six weeks. With it on, he opens door handles on the first try. His result is his own. Yours may differ.
page.proofLab: In our lab, he could squeeze about four times harder with the glove on. One person, one day. Not a promise.

faq.a: $399, one time. No subscription. Founding members on the list pay $349. Joining the list today costs nothing.

faq.q: Does it fit the left hand or the right hand?
faq.a: Both. We make left and right gloves. You can wear one on each hand.
Each glove is made to fit your hand. After you sign up, we send a short guide with three easy measurements.

faq.q: Will it work for my type of CMT?
faq.a: Capstan works from the outside of your hand. It closes your fingers and holds them. Your CMT type does not matter. Fit does, and we check fit with you before your glove ships.

faq.q: I have arthritis or a stroke, not CMT. Can I use it?
faq.a: Our first run is for people with CMT. Join the list and tell us about your hands. We will email you when it is ready for more conditions.

faq.q: Can I put it on with one hand?
faq.a: Capstan is built for one-handed use. We check this with you at your fitting. A short survey after you sign up asks which hand you use.

faq.q: What if it does not work for me?
faq.a: Send it back within 30 days for a full refund. One email is all it takes.
The first 500 gloves ship this fall. People on the list order first.

faq.q: I am researching this for a parent. What should I do?
faq.a: Join the list for them. We will send a one-page guide in plain words that you can print and hand over.

page.finalHead: Save your spot in the first 500.
page.scopeLine: Capstan is a mechanical grip aid. It does not treat or slow CMT.
